description: Terms and conditions for using Fernandes Journeys — personal use, no travel agency, acceptable use, accounts, and liability limits.
contentHtml:
Effective / last updated: September 21, 2026

Welcome to Fernandes Journeys, a personal travel journal by Alex Fernandes. By using https://www.fernandesjourneys.com, you agree to these Terms of Use. Questions: contact@fernandesjourneys.com.

What this site is (and isn't)

This is a personal journal — stories, photos, destination notes, and tools Alex actually uses. It is not a travel agency, booking desk, or licensed advisor. Nothing here is professional travel, legal, medical, or financial advice. Plans change; always double-check visas, safety, and prices yourself.

Personal use

Content is for your personal, non-commercial use. Please don't scrape, republish, or reuse photos and writing wholesale without permission. Linking to a story with credit is welcome; copying the journal is not.

No warranty

The site and content are provided "as is" without warranties of any kind — express or implied — including accuracy, completeness, or fitness for a particular purpose. Trip notes reflect personal experience at a point in time and may go out of date.

Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent allowed by law, Alex Fernandes / Fernandes Journeys is not liable for any loss, damage, injury, or expense arising from your use of the site, reliance on content, or bookings you make with third parties. Any action you take based on what you read here is at your own risk.

Acceptable use

  • Don't attack, overload, or probe the site; don't attempt unauthorized access to accounts, APIs, or /cms.
  • Don't use the site to spam, harass, or distribute malware.
  • Don't create accounts with false information or share account credentials.
  • Automated scraping that harms performance or bypasses protections (including Turnstile) is not allowed.

Accounts

Optional reader accounts (Google, X, or email/password) are for saving posts and managing your profile. Keep your password confidential. We may suspend or remove accounts that violate these terms or threaten the site. CMS access is limited to allowlisted admins — reader accounts never unlock publishing tools.

Comments

Where comments are enabled: keep them relevant and respectful; a valid email may be required; first-time comments may be moderated; spam, self-promotion, and abusive content will be removed. This is not a booking desk — advice shared is personal experience only.

Outbound & affiliate links

Some links (including on /tools) go to third-party sites. Those sites have their own terms and privacy practices. See the Affiliate & monetization disclosure for how commissions work.

Related policies

Your use of the site is also governed by our Privacy Policy and Affiliate disclosure. The Policies hub links all three.

Changes

We may update these terms as the product evolves. The effective date at the top will change when we do. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.
